public_health_question.v: What were the incidence, distribution and characteristics of nationally notifiable domestic arboviral disease cases in the United States in 2021?

ev.q: This report summarizes 2021 surveillance data reported to CDC by U.S. jurisdictions for nationally notifiable arboviruses
West Nile Virus and Other Nationally Notifiable Arboviral Diseases — United States, 2021
In 2021, a total of 3,035 domestic arboviral disease cases were reported to CDC.
Forty La Crosse virus disease cases were reported from eight jurisdictions.
Thirty-two Jamestown Canyon virus disease cases were reported from eight jurisdictions.
Twenty-four Powassan virus disease cases were reported from eight jurisdictions
Seventeen cases of St. Louis encephalitis virus disease were reported from three states
Five cases of eastern equine encephalitis virus disease were reported from four states

view_issues: 'Significant outbreak' is colloquial: the report has no tests, p-values or CIs. The SLE onset text conflicts with itself (August–November, yet 65% in October–December). The Table 2 Louisiana SLE cell lacks a closing parenthesis.
